# dsh-veripipe
A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that mints a **turn-terminal receipt** for every turn and keeps it r
eadable after the turn ends — plus a read-only tool to read receipts back. It adds no model calls, n
o network, and no writes to your session.
## The problem it solves
dsh ships a `todos` session projection that an agent updates with `todo_write`. That projection is *
*cleared on every `turn/start`**: once the next turn begins, reading the `todos` projection returns
`null`. An external verifier that inspects a session *between* turns therefore cannot tell a plan th
at finished (all todos `completed`) from one that was abandoned — both read as "no list".
`dsh-veripipe` folds the same event log into a parallel projection whose entries are **never cleared
by a later turn**. At each `turn/end` it records one receipt capturing that turn's terminal state,
so the completion status of every turn stays readable for the life of the session.
## What it registers
- **`veripipeReceipts` session projection** — a pure, deterministic fold over the session event log
(`turn/start`, `todo/write`, `goal/change`, `turn/end`). It mints one receipt per `turn/end` and kee
ps the newest 50. It replays from the log like any other projection; it stores no state of its own o

utside the event stream.
- **`veripipe_receipt` tool** — read-only. Returns the current session's mo
st recent receipts (default 1). It performs no model call, no network request, and no writes.

All `@deepseek-ai/*` packages are **peer dependencies** supplied by the host dsh installation; the p
lugin declares them as peers (not regular dependencies) on purpose. Declaring them as dependencies w
ould load a second copy of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and break every tool call. `zod` is the only dir
ect runtime dependency.
## Receipt fields
Each receipt is a small, JSON-plain record:
| Field | Type | Meaning |

| `turn` | integer | The turn number this receipt certifies (`-1` if the event omitted it). |
| `end
Reason` | string | The `turn/end` reason kind (e.g. `completed`, `aborted`, `error`); `unknown` if u

nreadable. |
| `todos` | object \| null | Counts of the last todo list written in the turn: `{ total

, completed, inProgress, pending }`, or `null` if none was written. |
| `goal` | object \| null | Go

al identity at turn end: `{ id, phase, revision }`, or `null` if no goal was active. |
| `verdict.pl
anComplete` | `pass` \| `fail` \| `inconclusive` | The fail-closed completion judgement (below). |
### Verdict semantics (fail-closed)
The verdict is deliberately conservative — uncertainty is never reported as `pass`:

- **`pass`** — a non-empty todo list was written this turn **and every item is `completed`**.
- **`f

ail`** — a non-empty todo list was written **and at least one item is not `completed`**.
- **`inconc
lusive`** — no todo list was written this turn, the list was empty, or the `todo/write` payload was
no todo list was written this turn, the list was empty, or the `todo/write` payload was unreadable.

Before the first turn ends, the tool returns `{ "available": 0, "returned": 0, "receipts": [] }`.
## Privacy
Receipts store **counts and identifiers only**. The fold never records prompts, todo text, tool argu
ments, tool results, or a goal's objective text — only per-status todo counts, the goal's `id`/`phas
e`/`revision`, the turn number, and the end-reason kind. The `veripipe_receipt` tool returns exactly
those fields and nothing more.
## Relation to veripipe
`veripipe` is an external verification pipeline that judges whether an agent actually completed the
task it was given. Its dsh adapter reads a session's state after the run. Because the stock `todos`
projection is cleared at the next `turn/start`, a between-turns read cannot distinguish a finished p
lan from an abandoned one. This plugin closes that gap on the dsh side: it exposes a durable, fail-c
losed, counts-only completion signal per turn that such a verifier can read without re-deriving hist
ory or touching private content. The plugin is independently useful without veripipe — it is a gener
al turn-completion ledger — and is maintained separately from the harness.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`lib/` is committed so installs need no build; rebuild and commit it after changing `src/`.
The whole computation lives in `src/receipt.ts`, which imports nothing from the harness and is unit-
tested in isolation against the compiled `lib/receipt.js`.
